original_idea.body:
# Measuring the Comprehensiveness Gap: What Cyber Attack Scenarios in MITRE ATT&CK Have No Corresponding Governance Provision?

**Problem:** MITRE ATT&CK documents hundreds of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures. AI governance frameworks address a small fraction. The unmapped fraction represents ungoverned dual-use risk.

**Direction:** For each of MITRE ATT&CK's 14 tactic categories (reconnaissance through impact), identify representative techniques. Test whether frontier models will provide assistance for each technique. Cross-reference results with governance framework coverage from the automated MITRE coverage tool. Identify the largest ungoverned technique clusters.

**Why it matters:** Governance frameworks address the most publicized risks but may have systematic blind spots in less-discussed ATT&CK categories. Mapping coverage to ATT&CK makes these gaps concrete and actionable.

**Relevant context:** MITRE ATT&CK; Linder et al. framework; NIST AI 800-1 cybersecurity appendix; automated coverage scorer idea.
